name: ultimate-plex-companion
description: A futuristic command centre for Plex

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.native:dev: node scripts/native-config.mjs macos && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json
scripts.native:build:macos: node scripts/native-config.mjs macos && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json --bundles app,dmg
scripts.native:build:android: node scripts/native-config.mjs android && tauri android build --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json
scripts.native:build:ios: node scripts/native-config.mjs ios && tauri ios build --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json
scripts.native:open:android: node scripts/native-config.mjs android && tauri android dev --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json --open
scripts.native:open:ios: node scripts/native-config.mjs ios && tauri ios dev --config src-tauri/tauri.generated.conf.json --open
